🏡 𝐀 𝐛𝐞𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐨𝐟𝐟𝐞𝐫 𝐜𝐚𝐧 𝐩𝐮𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐥𝐨𝐜𝐤.

Many buyers don't realize that a home sale contingency doesn't always guarantee unlimited time to sell their current home. ⏰

If a seller receives a stronger offer, they may give the original buyer a deadline to either remove the contingency or walk away from the deal.

That's why understanding the risks and timelines involved is so important before submitting a contingent offer.
